external_collaboration.evidence_quote: To help protect the marine habitat where we operate, the company partnered with Cornell University and the Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution to develop a state-of-the-art system that detects the presence of right whales. Building on advances in ocean mooring design, underwater acoustic systems, and telecommunications, the team built and installed ten “auto-detection buoys” to listen for the calls of right whales along the main shipping lanes into Massachusetts Bay and Boston Harbor.
